text: Renata's Operations team and Devon's Support team, in the same room, watching both surfaces work -- and talking honestly about the bug Support actually lived through before it was fixed.

The demo goes first: the trend report, then a live package lookup refreshed minutes apart so the status visibly moves. Only after both surfaces have proven themselves do we name ticket 4471 directly, instead of burying it.

Here's exactly what happened: a scanner buffered a routine re-scan during a signal gap, it arrived at Kafka forty minutes late, and Gold trusted that late arrival over the real, on-time delivery event. Support's own live lookup had it right the entire time.
Gold now orders by the scanner's own event time, never by arrival time, with a named regression test guarding it on every future change -- not just the word 'fixed.'
Both teams got a real answer, not just reassurance. Next: writing it all down so this platform doesn't depend on anyone remembering it.
